lessonTitle: 48. Review: vectors in the plane and in space
lessonTitleEnglish: Review: vectors in the plane and in space
unit: Geometry · Chapter II. Review of the course
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: Vectors add by the triangle or parallelogram rule; ka is collinear with a and |ka| = |k| · |a|.
stages.headlineEnglish: Vectors add by the triangle or parallelogram rule; ka is collinear with a and |ka| = |k| · |a|.

stages.headline: The scalar product: a · b = |a||b| cos φ = x₁x₂ + y₁y₂ + z₁z₂; a ⊥ b ⇔ a · b = 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: The scalar product: a · b = |a||b| cos φ = x₁x₂ + y₁y₂ + z₁z₂; a ⊥ b ⇔ a · b = 0.

stages.headline: Every vector in space is uniquely p = xa + yb + zc for three non-coplanar a, b, c.
stages.headlineEnglish: Every vector in space is uniquely p = xa + yb + zc for three non-coplanar a, b, c.
